title: Y2kScript best kill all skin changer and more
features:
Combat

 Hitbox / Reach Extender (size slider)
 Show Hitboxes (reveals real hurtbox zones)
 Camera Lock — sticky target, lock part (hurtbox/head/torso/HRP), smoothness, prediction, FOV, side keybind
 Triggerbot — gun (presses A on crosshair target) + sword (clicks in melee), mode, gun range, sword range, delay, side  keybind
 Auto Kill All — smooth tween-orbit each player, camera-aim, waits for death
 Parry Assist — reacts to glint + bullets + optional melee-proximity, parry key, range, delay, cue ESP
 Safe Zone — tweens to a fixed safe spot on instability/break (set-spot button, trigger %, return %, tween speed)

Movement

 TP Walk (speed)
 Noclip (ground mode, through walls)
 Velocity Booster (side keybind)
 Fly (side keybind, speed)
 Anti-AFK

Visuals

 Player ESP — boxes, names, distance, health bars, tracers, chams, color, max distance
 Fullbright, Remove Fog, Remove Combat Flashes, Custom FOV
 Atmosphere/Color — saturation, brightness, contrast, tint
 Custom Skins (first-person viewmodel)

 Sword / Gun / Arms — Rainbow / Glass / Neon / ForceField / Custom Color
 Effect skins — Parry / Slash / Ground Slam (Rainbow / Custom Color)
 Effect color picker

Misc

 Bullet Tracer recolor (all 4 tracers) + color
 Player list + Teleport to player
 Combat Feed (hits/kills)
 Kill Sound — custom sound ID, volume, test button
 Fast Respawn on death
 Rejoin, Server Hop, Copy Job ID

Other

Executor identity spoof
Right Ctrl menu toggle, configs/themes, full unload
